source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 2 (a)-(b): temperature model T(t) = (13/2) sin(pi t/6 - pi/9) + 15; maximum, minimum and T(9). Answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 2 (a) The temperature T in a certain city varies throughout the day according to the equation \(T(t) = \frac{13}{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{9}\right) + 15\), where \(t\) is the time in hours, with \(t = 0\) corresponding to midnight. Find the maximum and minimum temperature during the day.
blocks.explanation:
Temperature ka formula ek sine wave hai: \(a + b\sin(\ldots)\), jahan \(a = 15\) aur \(b = \frac{13}{2}\).
Humein din bhar ka sab se zyada aur sab se kam temperature chahiye.
Plan: \(-1 \le \sin \le 1\) se shuru kar ke \(\frac{13}{2}\) se multiply aur 15 jama; phir yeh bhi dekhna ke yeh values din ke andar waqai aati hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(T(t) = \tfrac{13}{2}\sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{6}t - \tfrac{\pi}{9}\right) + 15\), \(0 \le t < 24\) (aadhi raat se agli aadhi raat tak).
Humein find karna hai: \(T\) ka maximum aur minimum.
Tareeqa: Sine kisi bhi angle ka ho, \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai. Phir \(\frac{13}{2}\) se multiply aur 15 jama. Yeh wohi tareeqa hai jo Question 1 mein kiya, bas ab is ka matlab asal zindagi ka temperature hai.

Sine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{6}t - \tfrac{\pi}{9}\right) \le 1\]
Kyun: Angle kitna hi mushkil lage (\(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{9}\)), sine ki value \(-1\) se neeche ya \(1\) se upar nahi ja sakti. Andar ki cheezein sirf yeh tay karti hain ke temperature kis waqt upar neeche hoga.

\(\frac{13}{2}\) se multiply karein
\[-\tfrac{13}{2} \le \tfrac{13}{2}\sin(\ldots) \le \tfrac{13}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{13}{2} = 6.5\) positive hai, is liye nishan nahi badalte. Yeh 6.5 amplitude hai: temperature average se 6.5 degree upar aur 6.5 degree neeche tak jata hai.

15 jama karein
\[15 - 6.5 \le T \le 15 + 6.5\]
\[8.5 \le T \le 21.5\]
Kyun: 15 average (darmiyani) temperature hai, jis ke ird gird wave upar neeche hoti hai. Maximum \(= a + b\), minimum \(= a - b\).

Tasdeeq: kya yeh din ke andar hota hai?
\[\tfrac{\pi}{6}t - \tfrac{\pi}{9} = \tfrac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow t = \tfrac{11}{3}\]
\[\tfrac{\pi}{6}t - \tfrac{\pi}{9} = \tfrac{3\pi}{2} \Rightarrow t = \tfrac{29}{3}\]
Kyun: Sine \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par 1 aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par \(-1\) hota hai. \(t = \frac{11}{3}\) ghante yani raat 3:40 baje, aur \(t = \frac{29}{3}\) ghante yani subah 9:40 baje; dono din ke andar hain, is liye yeh dono values waqai milti hain.
Dhyan dein: Sawal "during the day" kehta hai; agar extreme value din ke bahar hoti to jawab badal sakta tha, is liye yeh check zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (b) The temperature T in a certain city varies throughout the day according to the equation \(T(t) = \frac{13}{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{9}\right) + 15\), where \(t\) is the time in hours, with \(t = 0\) corresponding to midnight. Find the temperature at \(t = 9\) hours (9:00 a.m.).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh substitution ka sawal hai: formula mein \(t = 9\) rakhna hai.
Asal kaam angle ko sahi nikalna hai (radians ya degrees mein).
Plan: pehle angle, phir us ka sine, aakhir mein \(T\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(T(t) = \tfrac{13}{2}\sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{6}t - \tfrac{\pi}{9}\right) + 15\), \(t = 9\).
Humein find karna hai: \(T(9)\), yani subah 9 baje ka temperature.
Tareeqa: \(t = 9\) rakh kar angle simplify karenge, phir \(\sin(270^{\circ} - 20^{\circ}) = -\cos 20^{\circ}\) use karenge. Calculator se bhi seedha nikal sakte hain, lekin radian mode mein.

Angle nikalein
\[\tfrac{\pi}{6}(9) - \tfrac{\pi}{9} = \tfrac{3\pi}{2} - \tfrac{\pi}{9}\]
\[= 270^{\circ} - 20^{\circ} = 250^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\pi\) radian \(= 180^{\circ}\). Is liye \(\frac{3\pi}{2} = \frac{3 \times 180^{\circ}}{2} = 270^{\circ}\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{9} = 20^{\circ}\). Degrees mein badalne se quadrant pehchanna aasaan ho jata hai.

Sine nikalein
\[\sin 250^{\circ} = \sin(270^{\circ} - 20^{\circ})\]
\[= -\cos 20^{\circ} \approx -0.9397\]
Kyun: \(250^{\circ}\) teesre quadrant (Quadrant III) mein hai, jahan sine negative hota hai. \(270^{\circ}\) se angle ghatane par sine, cosine mein badal jata hai: \(\sin(270^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\).
Dhyan dein: Calculator degree mode mein ho aur aap \(\sin(3\pi/2 - \pi/9)\) radians wala daal dein to jawab ghalat aayega; mode ka khayal rakhein.

\(T\) nikalein
\[T(9) = 6.5(-0.9397) + 15\]
\[= -6.108 + 15 = 8.892\]
Kyun: Sine ki value ko amplitude 6.5 se multiply kiya aur average 15 jama kiya. Negative sine ka matlab hai temperature average se neeche hai.

Tasdeeq
\[8.5 \le 8.89 \le 21.5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab part (a) ki range ke andar hai aur minimum ke bilkul qareeb hai. Yeh samajh mein bhi aata hai, kyunke minimum subah 9:40 par aata hai, yani 9 baje temperature taqreeban sab se kam hai.
